name: fast-lane
description: Docs or user-visible copy only (CLAUDE.md § Fast lane)

name: ready-for-agent
description: Fully specified, ready for an unattended agent

name: roadmap
description: A pull request that builds a roadmap milestone; the triage digest groups these

name: contract
description: Adds or changes what a component promises; always needs sign-off

name: needs-person
description: Automation proposed this; a named person must decide

name: fix-proposal
description: A diagnosis and proposed fix (or quarantine proposal) for a red run; a person decides

name: unreviewed-contract
description: Contract drafted from the code, bugs included; check against intent before signing off

name: triage-proposal
description: Triage suggested labels, duplicates or a pickup prompt; a person applies them
